title: Dental PPO Plans Pediatric Benefit and Dependent Age Schedule
content:
Age limits and pediatric out-of-pocket maximums of the Dental PPO Plans, per plan.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dependent child age limit (years) | 26 | 26 | 26 | 26 | 26 | 26 |
| Pediatric essential-health-benefit age limit (years) | 19 | 19 | 19 | 19 | 19 | 19 |
| Pediatric out-of-pocket maximum, one child (USD per benefit period) | 0.00 | 425.00 | 0.00 | 425.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| Pediatric out-of-pocket maximum, two or more children (USD per benefit period) | 0.00 | 850.00 | 0.00 | 850.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

**Dependent child age limit.** A child's enrollment ends at the end of the month in which the child reaches this birthday.

**Pediatric essential-health-benefit age limit.** On individual exchange enrollments, a covered person who has not reached this birthday on the date of service receives the pediatric essential-health-benefit treatment: no annual maximum, and an out-of-pocket maximum applies.

**Pediatric out-of-pocket maximum, one child.** The pediatric out-of-pocket maximum for one covered child on an individual exchange enrollment, per benefit period; 0.00 means the plan is not exchange-filed.

**Pediatric out-of-pocket maximum, two or more children.** The combined pediatric out-of-pocket maximum when two or more children of the subscriber are enrolled on individual exchange enrollments; 0.00 means the plan is not exchange-filed.

### Reading the schedule
Only Value 1000 and Plus 1500 show pediatric out-of-pocket maximums above 0.00; these are the exchange-filed plans. A person whose 19th birthday falls on the date of service has reached the age limit on that date.
